runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script
runs.failure_point: It printed every amount snippet from every executed agreement in one call, and the run ended on context overflow before any response was written.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.critic_note: The run ended inside the stage, before its stage_end review.
first_error.why: A script printing every dollar snippet from every executed-agreement file in the store returned about 4.8M characters, filled the context and ended the run without a response.

divergence: T0 and T1 pass; T2 fails without a deliverable. All three listed the store and tried a store-wide settlement-amount scan that timed out. They split at that scan: T0 and T1 saved scan output to files and printed compact per-matter indexes, then read 7 to 30 executed settlement agreements and compared defined amounts, settling on the same matter; T2 printed every dollar snippet from every executed agreement in one call (about 4.8M characters) and the run ended on context overflow before any review could react. The passing runs declared many agent-defined stages, mostly at reviewers' suggestion (summaries of scan output, candidate verification, post-writing source checks); all fit existing stages. T0 then ran long post-writing loops (six check attempts, two further scans and two candidate reads) without changing its answer.
